meta.description:
Executa a cada 30 minutos via Schedule Trigger. Busca agendamentos que precisam de lembrete via RPC get_appointments_needing_reminder (start_at dentro da janela configurada em email_reminder_hours / whatsapp_reminder_hours e *_reminder_sent_at IS NULL).

Para cada agendamento:
  1. Verifica se e-mail está habilitado → chama send-agenda-email → marca email_reminder_sent_at
  2. Verifica se WhatsApp está habilitado → chama send-message → marca reminder_sent_at

Ambos os canais são independentes — cada um pode estar habilitado individualmente.

VARIÁVEIS DE AMBIENTE necessárias no n8n:
  SUPABASE_URL         = https://owwaulaenabbdalycusx.supabase.co
  SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = eyJ...

IMPORTANTE: Este workflow precisa da RPC get_appointments_needing_reminder no Supabase.
Crie via SQL Editor:

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_appointments_needing_reminder()
RETURNS TABLE (...) LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
  SELECT
    a.id, a.client_id, a.customer_name, a.customer_email, a.customer_phone,
    a.whatsapp_notify_phone, a.service_name, a.start_at, a.end_at,
    a.email_reminder_sent_at, a.reminder_sent_at,
    s.email_notify_enabled, s.email_notify_on_reminder, s.email_reminder_hours,
    s.whatsapp_notify_enabled, s.whatsapp_notify_on_reminder, s.whatsapp_reminder_hours
  FROM public.client_appointments a
  JOIN public.client_ai_settings s ON s.client_id = a.client_id
  WHERE a.status IN ('confirmed', 'pending')
    AND a.start_at > now()
    AND (
      (s.email_notify_enabled AND s.email_notify_on_reminder
       AND a.email_reminder_sent_at IS NULL
       AND a.start_at <= now() + (s.email_reminder_hours || ' hours')::interval)
      OR
      (s.whatsapp_notify_enabled AND s.whatsapp_notify_on_reminder
       AND a.reminder_sent_at IS NULL
       AND a.start_at <= now() + (s.whatsapp_reminder_hours || ' hours')::interval)
    );
$$;
